name: The Defense of Grom'gol
label: Quest
description: Commander Aggro'gosh seeks to safeguard the Horde's foothold in Stranglethorn Vale and protect their supply chain to Stonard. To keep that supply chain…
intro: Commander Aggro'gosh seeks to safeguard the Horde's foothold in Stranglethorn Vale and protect their supply chain to Stonard. To keep that supply chain safe, he directs Horde champions to thin out the Lashtail Raptors outside Grom'gol Base Camp.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your arrival at Grom'gol is timely, indeed. As commander of the Warchief's base camp here in the jungle I am bound by honor to ensure the safety of all members of the Horde. Our mission to provide a safe chain of supply to Stonard is being hampered by some of the local inhabitants.
I am putting you in charge of thinning out the raptor population outside of Grom'gol. Once you have made significant progress, report back to me for reassignment.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Our supply efforts are still being hampered by the indigenous raptor population, adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your duty was performed with honor, adventurer.
